comments.author: ShitaiA
comments.body:
i would vote for FLC. Althought MLS can have better vertical (good at headwind/head-side wind) and slighter more total sails.

Here are the reasons:
- base stats 6 more turns, 4 more armours, 2 more waves. More turns and armours gives better acceleration speed. Waves resistance gives more top speed.
- If you can pick a good route, you can aviod headwind.
- good acceleration, more cannons and the super top seed allow you to have better self defence. faster to run away from plunder. Pirate with slower acceleration can only sink you other then melee/plunder you. Combine with original ship building skill like: heavy bombing/Explosive shell/Bullet-proof armouring can make even more advantage in this too. Word very good in piracy for the same reason as well
- can turn to a battler trade ship then MLS: about 80+ more cargo
- in the view of SB, 2nd optional skill is better in FLC. Floatsom search: casting net (+ turns), mast top (+ sails), which MLS doesnt have. The extra speed from mast top allows you to use metal work for +3 armour (-10v/h), more armour gives more acceleration again, and better defence of cos.

Here is the most expensive/crazy plan for FLC ^_^:
